power.method: External DC power supply (Wi-Fi does not carry power)

features: near and far lens views with picture-in-picture
infrared and white-light colour night modes
release_notes: Specs per the official QuarkView product page (Shenzhen Kuake Trading Co., Ltd.); the page states two lenses labelled 4MP each (8MP combined sensor count, explicitly not one 4K stream), near/far picture-in-picture views (no continuous optical-zoom ratio despite the 8X naming), remote pan/tilt, human tracking, IP66, two-way audio, microSD up to 128GB, Wi-Fi with external DC power and the iCSee app. No ONVIF or RTSP is stated and the linked PT Wi-Fi family manual documents no RTSP path, so no configs are given. Focal lengths, field of view, codecs, sensor and dimensions are not published.
